release.body:
Your free days are calm now: the overview shows one quiet line with the date they end, and no plan buttons. Want the trial earlier? Start it any time from Account.

On the last day, one short reminder appears with a Start trial link.

When the free days are over, Yap says so plainly: the overview holds one button to start your 10-day trial, and pressing your shortcut takes you straight there. A failed payment or an ended plan works the same way, with the one button that fixes it.

Yap now tells your account on which days it finished a dictation and how many. Never what you said: no audio, no text, no app names.

release.body:
Yap now works the moment you install it. A new installation dictates for 3 days with no account and no card: open Yap, hold your shortcut and speak. Your free days start the first time you open it, while you are online.

When you want to keep going, open Account and choose Start 10-day trial. Your browser opens to sign in, add a card and connect this PC. The trial renews at USD 6.90 a month or USD 69 a year unless you cancel before it ends.

Already subscribed? Nothing changes for you.
